about_the_game:
A mysterious miasma spreads across the world, turning local wildlife into terrifying monsters. Guilds, once dedicated to everyday tasks, are now the last line of defense against this growing threat.

Guild of Hunters is a turn-based RPG where you lead a guild of hunters, recruit new members, negotiate item prices with merchants, and embark on dangerous expeditions through a medieval world filled with secrets and challenges.

Assemble the perfect team, combining unique skills and strategies to face dark creatures and uncover the origin of the corruption plaguing the land. With deep combat mechanics, resource management, and impactful choices, every decision shapes the future of your guild—and the world itself.

🔹 Recruit and train hunters with different skills and specializations.
🔹 Trade with merchants to get the best equipment and supplies.
🔹 Explore dangerous regions, from haunted forests to forgotten ruins.
🔹 Engage in tactical turn-based battles, where strategy is key to victory.
🔹 Uncover the truth behind the miasma and face increasingly powerful enemies.

Build your guild, hunt the monsters, negotiate with merchants, upgrade your itens and restore peace.
